name: kiln
description: AI agent control of real 3D printers — design, slice, print, monitor, and recover across Bambu Lab, Creality, Prusa, Elegoo, and more.
long_description:
Kiln is an open-source MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, or any custom MCP client) drive real 3D printers end to end. In a single conversation, an agent can design a part, slice it, queue it on the right printer, monitor the camera, recover from failures, and ship the result — over OctoPrint, Moonraker/Klipper, PrusaLink, Direct USB, and Bambu Lab's native protocol.

This bundle installs Kiln locally so it can reach a printer on your own network — Kiln is fundamentally a local-first tool, not a hosted service.

printer_host.title: Printer host / URL
printer_host.description: URL of your 3D printer (OctoPrint, Moonraker, Creality, or Prusa Link). Optional — you can also register printers from inside the chat.

printer_type.title: Printer type
printer_type.description: octoprint, moonraker, creality, bambu, prusalink, elegoo, or serial

printer_api_key.title: Printer API key
printer_api_key.description: API key for your printer's REST API, if it requires one
